subject: Hospitality
title: Accessibility as Standard
description: A short lesson to help you apply Accessibility as Standard.

hook.text: One billion people live with disabilities. Yet most hotels treat accessibility as a legal checkbox, not a design priority.

buildup.text: Accessible tourism is worth $58 billion annually. Disabled travelers are loyal to brands that truly accommodate them.

discovery.text: Leaders like Scandic Hotels train every employee in accessibility and offer detailed room-by-room accessibility info online.

twist.text: Most hotel websites still lack basic accessibility info. Guests with disabilities often can't determine if a room actually works.

climax.text: Universal design benefits everyone—wider doors help luggage, grab bars help all ages, and clear signage aids every guest.

punchline.text: Design for disability and you design for everyone. Inclusion is universal hospitality.

quiz.question: How much is the accessible tourism market worth annually?
